mechanism: Chlorpromazine may potentiate tobramycin's nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity through additive renal and eighth cranial nerve damage; chlorpromazine also causes orthostatic hypotension which may be exacerbated by aminoglycoside-induced volume depletion.
action: Monitor renal function (BUN, creatinine) closely, assess hearing baseline and during therapy, maintain adequate hydration, consider alternative antibiotics if possible, and monitor blood pressure in supine and standing positions.
